Half a Beat (慢半拍) — Silhouette Rhythm (Lemo-Opuscar) · LemoLab × Claude Opus 5.5

No AI-generated images, no photographs, no stock footage. Every silhouette, the sky, the water and every
ripple and droplet are drawn in code (film.js, shapes.js, sky.js).

FONTS (SIL Open Font License 1.1; not in git: build.sh downloads them from github.com/google/fonts and
make_fonts.py subsets them; licence texts in fonts/)
- Anton — The Anton Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/AntonFont), ofl/anton/Anton-Regular.ttf
  — fonts/OFL-Anton.txt
- Barlow Condensed Medium — The Barlow Project Authors (https://github.com/jpt/barlow),
  ofl/barlowcondensed/BarlowCondensed-Medium.ttf — fonts/OFL-BarlowCondensed.txt
- Noto Sans SC (variable, instanced at 900 and 500) — Google / Adobe, ofl/notosanssc/NotoSansSC[wght].ttf
  — fonts/OFL-NotoSansSC.txt

SOUND
- Score and foley are made in code (audio.py). The foley (splashes, wingbeats, drips, distant calls, a
  record scratch, a slide whistle, wind and water) is synthesised.
- Drums: "MuldjordKit" by Lars Muldjord (drumgizmo.org), FreePats version, licensed under CC BY 4.0
  (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
- Samples (CC0): FreePats project (freepats.zenvoid.org) — kalimba; Karoryfer Samples / sfzinstruments — bass;
  VS Chamber Orchestra: Community Edition (Versilian Studios) — violins, cellos, log drum, bass drum;
  Versilian Community Sample Library (Versilian Studios) — marimba, vibraphone, glockenspiel, hand chimes,
  harp, woodblock, claps, shaker, conga, cajon.
  Fetch with: sh tools/fetch.sh instruments vcsl; vsco2ce; freepats; karoryfer.

BEHAVIOUR
- No numbers or claims appear on screen. What the flamingos do follows real birds: group marching and
  head-flagging displays, a running start across the water to take off, flight with neck and legs stretched
  out. The young bird's shorter, straighter bill and downy outline are a character design, not a field guide.

import numpy as np
X=sx=SFX=sfx
rng=np.random.default_rng(97)
sfx._rng=np.random.default_rng(97)
DUR=1.4
N=round(DUR*SR)
t=np.arange(12000)/SR


def wing(v=1.0, d=.22):  # one wingbeat: a soft low push
    tt = t_(d); x = lp(bp(noise(d), 120, 1400), 900) * np.sin(np.pi * tt / d) ** 2
    return norm(x) * v

samples = wing()
